description: This file defines the CategoryModel class and sample data lists representing product categories with images and SVG icons, used in an e-commerce UI.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Model class representing a product category, including title, optional image URL, optional SVG icon source, and optional subcategories.

methods.name: CategoryModel
methods.description: Constructor for creating instances of CategoryModel with required title and optional image, SVG source, and subcategories.
